title: 1987 Constitution, Article III — Bill of Rights
notes: Sections 1–22. Covers right to remain silent (§12), right against unreasonable search/seizure (§2), due process (§1), equal protection (§1), free speech (§4).

title: RA 7438 — Rights of Persons Arrested, Detained or Under Custodial Investigation
notes: PH Miranda rights equivalent. Right to counsel, to remain silent, to be informed of rights. Custodial investigation definition.

title: RA 9745 — Anti-Torture Act of 2009
notes: Defines torture; rights of persons during detention; prohibition on evidence obtained through torture.

title: Rules of Court, Rule 113 — Arrest
notes: Lawful arrest with and without warrant (Sec.5). In flagrante delicto, hot pursuit. Rights of the arrested.

title: RA 6975 — Department of Interior and Local Government Act (PNP Act)
notes: PNP operational procedures; limits of police authority; accountability.

title: RA 4136 — Land Transportation and Traffic Code
notes: Driver's license requirements, apprehension rules, confiscation scope (license vs OR/CR).

title: RA 7924 — MMDA Charter
notes: MMDA powers and limitations; traffic enforcement jurisdiction vs LTO.

title: RA 6539 — Anti-Carnapping Act (as amended by RA 10883)
notes: OR/CR vs license confiscation distinction. Vehicle registration requirements.

title: Labor Code of the Philippines (PD 442 as amended)
notes: Illegal dismissal (Art.294/279), security of tenure, separation pay (Art.298/283), just/authorized causes.

title: PD 851 — 13th Month Pay Decree
notes: Mandatory 13th month pay for rank-and-file employees; coverage; computation; deadline (Dec 24).

title: RA 7877 — Anti-Sexual Harassment Act of 1995
notes: Sexual harassment in work/training/education; employer duties; complaint process.

title: RA 11313 — Safe Spaces Act (Bawal Bastos Law)
notes: Gender-based harassment in public, online, and workplace settings. Catcalling, wolf-whistling. Covers all genders.

title: RA 6727 — Wage Rationalization Act (minimum wage)
notes: Minimum wage setting via Regional Tripartite Wages and Productivity Boards. Cards must link to current regional wage order from DOLE.

title: RA 7160 — Local Government Code (Barangay provisions)
section: Book III, Title I — The Barangay
notes: Powers of barangay officials (punong barangay, kagawad); Katarungang Pambarangay (Secs.399–422); Lupon Tagapamayapa; barangay ordinance powers and limits.

title: RA 7394 — Consumer Act of the Philippines
notes: Right to refund/replacement; price tag law (displaying prices mandatory); deceptive/unfair sales acts; product safety; DTI enforcement.

title: DTI Memorandum Circular No.10-2020 — No Return No Exchange Policy
notes: 'No return, no exchange' signs are illegal under MC 10-2020 and RA 7394. Consumer has right to repair/replacement/refund for defective goods within warranty.

title: RA 8792 — Electronic Commerce Act
notes: Online seller obligations; electronic transactions; consumer protection in e-commerce.
